card.line: The Kidron is a valley just east of Jerusalem. Kings crossed it in sorrow, and godly kings used it to destroy idols and clean out unclean things.

moments.title: David crosses in tears
moments.text: As David leaves Jerusalem, the king crosses the Kidron Valley while everyone in the countryside weeps loudly. The people pass on toward the way of the wilderness.

moments.title: Shimei's warning
moments.text: King Solomon tells Shimei that on the day he crosses the Kidron Valley, he will die. He must stay in Jerusalem.

moments.title: Asa burns an idol
moments.text: Asa removes his grandmother Maacah as queen mother because she made a detestable Asherah pole. He chops it down and burns it in the Kidron Valley.

moments.title: Hezekiah's cleansing
moments.text: The priests cleanse the house of the LORD and bring out the unclean things they find. The Levites carry them out to the Kidron Valley.

moments.title: Josiah destroys idols
moments.text: King Josiah has the articles made for Baal and Asherah burned in the fields of Kidron. He also burns the Asherah pole in the valley and throws the dust of the pulverized altars into it.
